title: Whoop Recovery vs Perceived Effort Divergence
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=whoop:day
| search recovery_score=* rpe=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(recovery_score) as avg_recovery_score avg(rpe) as avg_rpe by _time
| eval divergence=round(avg_rpe-(avg_recovery_score/10),2)
| sort - _time
description: Examines Whoop recovery versus perceived effort divergence.
value: Divergence days show when the wearable and the athlete story are disagreeing in a useful way.
implementation: Send Whoop recovery versus perceived effort divergence events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of Whoop recovery versus perceived effort divergence, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It turns what is happening with Whoop recovery versus perceived effort divergence, so odd changes stand out quickly.
